# tool/export_csv.py
import csv

def export_csv(rows, path):
    f = open(path, "w")
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    for r in rows:
        writer.writerow(r)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    bad = [[b"\xff\xfe", "x"]]
    export_csv(bad, "out.csv")
